note: Jackson County park and landing on the Chattahoochee River arm of Lake Seminole near Bascom, with open camping loops and a USACE-owned single-lane boat ramp. Wide loops fit a 23-ft rig. --Claude

flags: Inclusion: no live official web presence for camping. Jackson County's parks page lists 'Neal's Landing - 7001 Hwy. 2 Bascom' only under 'Recreational Areas, Boat Ramps and Landings', with no mention of camping; USACE's Lake Seminole camping pages list only Hales Landing, River Junction and Eastbank. Aggregators disagree: AllStays lists 10 sites with water, showers and a dump station; a wanderlog.com review says the campground 'has been closed for a while' and another quotes $5 (no hookups) / $15 (electric+water) with a camp host. The original inclusion evidence was satellite only. Needs a call to Jackson County Parks & Recreation, (850) 557-1564, to confirm camping is open.
